description: Condition must carry a resolvable encounter reference (satusehat_encounter_id) pointing to an Encounter that exists, when a SatuSehat encounter linkage is expected (i.e. satusehat_encounter_id is populated).
Procedure must carry a resolvable encounter reference (satusehat_encounter_id) pointing to an Encounter that exists, when a SatuSehat encounter linkage is expected.
Observation must carry a resolvable encounter reference (satusehat_encounter_id) pointing to an Encounter that exists, when a SatuSehat encounter linkage is expected.
Encounter.status (fhir_status) must be one of the three statuses SatuSehat requires be sent: arrived, in-progress, finished.
Encounter.period_start must be less than or equal to Encounter.period_end.

Patient.uid, when populated, is expected to match a 16-digit numeric format. The field's authoritative definition (whether this represents NIK) has not been confirmed by the data owner -- this is a structural format check only, not a regulatory identity-validation rule.
